doc.title: Junior Mance Part II interviewed by Monk Rowe, New York City, New York, January 18, 1999 [interview 2 of 2]

title: Recent travels: Japan, Europe, Toronto and the 100 Gold Fingers Tour
summary: Mance updates on his recent travels, including Japan, Europe, and annual Toronto festival and club dates.

story.theme_name: Going abroad: American jazz musicians touring and living in Europe
story.community_name: Going abroad: touring Europe and Japan

blocks.x: I’ve been looking forward to following up on some of the things we talked about the first time, and actually wanted to get an update on where you’ve been. I know you are well traveled.
So since — gee it’s been two years I think at least. What are some highlights of the places you’ve been since then?

Well I go to Japan a lot. I still do the 100 Gold Fingers Tour. In fact we’re doing it this year, it starts in May, May 23rd, until June 8th, and we’re doing that again. And I’ve been pretty much to most of the same places, most out of the country though. To Japan, Europe or Canada. I go to Toronto a lot. I do the jazz festival there and there’s a club there I play annually.
